svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1073 commits across five public projects, 75 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-07-27 through 2026-10-18 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-10-18T00:58:05.766Z.
